description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'SetExam1' web page in the Online Examination System. It contains event handlers for button clicks that perform server-side page transfers to various other pages within the application.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: Partial class for the web page allowing navigation to different sections of the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for profile button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: theoryB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Theory Set page.

methods.name: mcqB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the MCQ Set page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Login Page, effectively logging out.
